intro: Thank you for your faithfulness in giving. Every gift supports the ministry and mission of Shiloh Baptist Church.

methods.details: Bring the Whole Tithe and your Offering with you to church on Sunday: Bring the family and your friends too! Invite someone you don’t know to come as well, Jesus is Calling. He is coming back SOON!
Mail your Tithe and Offering: Shiloh Baptist Church, 477 Broad Street, Bridgeport, CT. 06604
